name: Fluidez de Movimiento Corporal
algorithm: Body Movement Fluidity — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes body movement naturalness for deepfake detection following Zheng et al. (2021):

1. **Pose Estimación**: Full-body or upper-body pose is estimated per frame using landmark detection (shoulders, elbows, wrists, head, torso). Joint angles and positions are tracked to build temporal motion trajectories for each body part.

2. **Movimiento Smoothness Análisis**: Natural body movements follow minimum-jerk trajectories (Flash & Hogan, 1985) — meaning the third derivative of position (jerk) is minimized. The method computes jerk profiles for tracked joints. AI-generated body movements may violate this biological constraint, showing either excessive jerk (unnatural abruptness) or unnaturally perfect smoothness (lacking physiological tremor).

3. **Joint Coordination Patterns**: Natural movements exhibit coordinated joint motion governed by biomechanical coupling. The method analyzes inter-joint correlations — shoulder-elbow coordination during gestures, head-torso coupling during turns. Deepfakes may produce joints that move independently in physically impossible ways.

4. **Temporal Frecuencia Análisis**: Body motion signals are analyzed in frequency domain. Natural movements contain characteristic frequency components: voluntary motion (0-2 Hz), physiological tremor (~8-12 Hz), and postural sway (~0.5 Hz). Generated movements may lack these physiological frequency signatures or produce spectrally flat motion without natural frequency structure.

5. **Fluidity Puntuación**: Movement fluidity is quantified by combining jerk metrics, coordination scores, and spectral indicators. Low fluidity scores (jerky, uncoordinated, or spectrally abnormal motion) indicate AI generation. The method is particularly effective for full-body deepfakes where generation artifacts extend beyond the face region.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante body movement fluidity analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
Tolosana, R. et al. (2020). DeepFakes and Beyond: A Survey of Face Manipulation and Detection. Information Fusion.
